explication: Colly is a Go crawling and scraping framework. A caller configures a Collector and starts a visit; Colly fetches pages, turns responses into HTML/XML representations, and invokes registered callbacks to extract data or schedule further visits. The request queue supports concurrent crawling, while storage tracks visited requests and cookies. README capabilities also include caching, robots.txt, per-domain delay/concurrency, distributed storage, environment configuration, and extensions. Those subsystems are represented at their documented source locations; their detailed wiring is not inferred where source excerpts were unavailable.
